description: Create a report (filter/view) for a form. Supports filter conditions, grouping, the sum/average per group, visible columns, sorting. For dates: yesterday, today, last_7_days, last_30_days, this_month, this_week, between (+ from/to), before, after and so on.

asc.description: true = ascending (default), false = descending. Applies to sort_by.

average_by_group.description: 1 = show the average of a number field for each group. average_by_group_column_id must be given.

average_by_group_column_id.description: ID or name of the number field whose average per group is counted.

criterias.description: Filter conditions. For dates: yesterday, today, today_or_later, before_today, last_7_days, last_30_days, last_60_days, this_week, this_month, next_7_days, next_30_days, next_60_days, next_90_days, next_120_days (a window that moves with the day: «due in the next 60 days» = next_60_days, no from/to), between (+ from/to — two fixed calendar dates as YYYY-MM-DD, never a word like «today»), before, after. For texts: is, is_not, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, is_empty, is_not_empty. For numbers: is, is_not, less_than, greater_than, between.

search_n.description: N for last_n_days, next_n_days and so on

group_field_ids.description: IDs of the fields to group by (GROUP BY). For example, group by status.

no_data_text.description: The text the owner sees when NO record matches the report's filters. ⚠️ ALWAYS write it for reports with a filter — a new project has no records yet, so this report is first shown empty. In the user's language and about THEIR business: «No visits today yet — they will appear here as soon as a client books», not «no data».

only_groupname_and_count.description: 1 = show only the group's name and its number of records (no details)

order.description: asc or desc — the sort direction of the GROUPS (only when group_field_ids is given). This is NOT a sort field — use sort_by for that.

property_ids.description: IDs or names of the fields shown (empty = all)

sort_by.description: ID or name of the field to sort the records by (used together with asc).

total_by_group.description: 1 = show the sum of a number field for each group. total_by_group_column_id must be given.

total_by_group_column_id.description: ID or name of the number field whose sum per group is counted.

name: create_report
